summary: Steep east kerb with houses 15 m away; cars park on the other side.
reasons: Houses about 15 m from the kerb

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 15 m away on this side and flats 21-22 m across the road; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; some cars park beside the kerb here, so room in line with them.
drivers.convention: No parking signs on this stretch; cars park nearby on the same street.

flags: Steep: about 8% over best section, 12.6% max
Dwellings within 10-25 m on both sides
Nearby stretches of Warren Street carry No Stopping signs
sun_shade: Street trees shade the kerb, especially mid-section; houses on the east shade the morning.

best_section.where: East kerb, beside the row of detached houses with front gardens
